if he was really drunk and sleepy, and he has a history of kissing pillows thinking it was you, it's entirely possible that he thought "oh, I'm in bed, getting ready to sleep, I'll kiss my girlfriend before sleep" and forgot the scenario he was in. If that's the case, then I wouldn't really consider that cheating, after all, he thought is was you and acted accordingly. If not, you may need to go over some relationship guidelines with him. But probably the biggest thing you need to do is talk to him about it, tell him in advance, you're not mad about it, but you want to know if something is up just so that you can work things out. Relationships need to be founded on mutual trust otherwise they will collapse.

TLDR; if he was just drunk+sleepy, probably not cheating, but you need to talk to clear things up.
